properties.name: session.cookie-name
properties.description: HttpOnly cookie name that carries the opaque session token.

properties.name: session.cookie-secure
properties.description: Whether the session cookie is marked Secure.

properties.name: session.cookie-same-site
properties.description: SameSite attribute for the session cookie (Lax locally, None in production cross-origin).

properties.name: session.idle-timeout
properties.description: Inactivity window after which the session is revoked.

properties.name: session.absolute-timeout
properties.description: Hard lifetime of a session from creation, regardless of activity.

properties.name: session.slide-interval
properties.description: Minimum time between last-seen / idle-expiry writes.
